detail.command:
printf '%s
' '=== STATUS ==='; git status --short; printf '%s
' '=== PACKAGE ==='; cat package.json; printf '%s
' '=== SRC TREE ==='; find src -maxdepth 3 -type f -print | sort; printf '%s
' '=== TEST TREE ==='; find tests -maxdepth 3 -type f -print 2>/dev/null | sort; printf '%s
' '=== CONTRACTS ==='; find src -type f \( -iname '*contract*' -o -iname '*config*' -o -iname '*type*' \) -print | sort | while read f; do echo "--- $f"; sed -n '1,240p' "$f"; done
